title: Q1
description:
The first covenant's sanctuary: lampstand, table, showbread, the golden censer, ark, cherubim, mercy seat.
Read: Exo 25–26, Exo 30:1–10, Lev 16:12–13
a) Exo 30:6 places the incense altar before the veil, yet its incense served the Most Holy Place on the Day of Atonement (Lev 16:12–13). What does that background bring forward into the way Hebrews groups it with the Holiest?
b) What could the priests do daily, and what only once a year?
